coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary recall of actual healthcare service loss, CMS access-risk actions, and concrete restorations in the United States and territories. Primary production Care Line collector remains authoritative.

cms_public_notices.result: The live CMS listing begins with seven notices dated October 30 (two CA hospices, MI psychiatric residential treatment facility, four home health agencies). coverage_notes.status_rationale: SUCCESS: CMS official listing accessible and all twelve targeted search requests completed; no new qualifying, nonduplicate access event established.
coverage_notes.limitations: Search results and local/territorial indexing are non-exhaustive; rural, tribal, and territory service changes may not be indexed promptly. Absence of a recall finding does not establish absence of service disruption. The production national collector remains authoritative.
coverage_notes.controls: Exactly one private ops/watch-ledger heartbeat, no approvals, production publication, primary-collector edits, schedule changes, or disabling.
